statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); dir=$(printf '%s' "$cwd" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; branch=$(git -C "$cwd" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); printf '\033[1;36m%s\033[0m' "$dir"; if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf ' \033[1;35m%s\033[0m' "$branch"; [ -n "$(git -C "$cwd" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] && printf ' \033[1;31m[!]\033[0m'; fi; printf ' \033[2m%s\033[0m' "$model"; [ -n "$used" ] && printf ' \033[2mctx %.0f%%\033[0m' "$used"; true
